notes: 15 groups. Searches: 2 of 2 used, both on the two congregations whose website field was an email address (Righteous Healing found no page; Sanctuary Fellowship led to its own site, sfwcenter.com, which was then fetched). records.notes: The site describes work with schools, colleges, and organizations on planning, professional learning for educators, and technical help. It lists no public classes, events, volunteering, or membership; its calls to action are Work with us and Partner with us. Treated as a service provider, not a group a visitor can join. The menu items Teach STEM in PA and Programs and Services were not read. The only date on the page is a 2026 copyright, which is not counted.

records.notes: The site presents play design and research work, including a playground project in Omaha, Nebraska, with pages for presentations, resources, and press. The only dated text is a 2025 copyright line, which is not counted.
